info.name: Parth
info.description:
This project allows users to personalize their web browsing experience by replacing the default "Google" logo on the homepage or search bar area with their own name or custom logo. Using browser extensions like Stylish or Tampermonkey, or by creating a custom HTML file, users can simulate a customized search engine interface for fun or branding purposes.

Whether you're aiming to surprise someone, create a unique homepage, or just enjoy a more personalized look, this method offers a creative way to make the search page feel more "yours." This is purely a visual modification and does not affect Google's actual functionality or backend.
